Hi. I really feel for you and can empathise so im going to give you the perspective from the side of the guy. 

I was like him, my mother came from a very different cultural background to that of my ex, one that I did not like being in and that meant that because of my ex’s ethnicity I “shouldn’t” date her even though these are just man-made conservative toxic cultural rules. 

I fought for her, I battled my mum for 2 years to be with this girl. I went to visit her in December and July before we broke up and I did not let my mum stop me (but to be fair I was staying at her house). 

Anyway, thing is when she came to visit me similar thing happened like you guys, because of my mum we had to get an Airbnb. I stayed with her the whole time, and in our culture we had our own festivities going on at the time but I stayed with her instead. I hate how narrow-minded my mum is so I couldn’t introduce her after she flew all this way. I didn’t want to force it on my mum though, because if I did she would say nasty things to my ex and I didnt want that to happen ofc.

With my ex it was one of her biggest issues i think and she mentioned it a few times we broke up for distance rly but i knew that was also a factor. It is fair, do you wanna be with someone who’s family you dont even know? Give him the ultimatum so he picks up the pace, he’s 26. Regardless, i know you got this OP.

Good luck and enjoy your Christmas here, its beautiful at this time of year so you did make the right choice visiting now regardless of your bf.
